business_problem: Daikin's acquisition-driven growth left it with diverse workflows, customized systems and fragmented data across order management, supply chain, fulfillment and finance, making it hard to deliver a consistent dealer experience or scale its operations efficiently across North America.
solution_summary: Daikin aligned its North American transformation around a 'One Daikin' operating model built on SAP S/4HANA and reusable capabilities on SAP Business Technology Platform. EY and SAP teams began with immersive discovery across dealer, branch counter and back-office personas, then designed fit-to-standard workflows for sales, logistics, procurement, warehouse and finance operations. The program replaced fragmented regional screens with single-screen workflows, mobile-first dealer capabilities and consolidated finance and warehouse experiences so branches could work from a common digital core. AI was embedded in both delivery and operations: AI-assisted code generation, automated testing, statistical forecasting, conversational interfaces and decision support accelerated rollout and improved fulfillment and planning. Governance controls, traceability and audit-ready reporting were built in early so the transformation could scale predictably across branches and future regions.

data_flow: Dealer, branch and back-office data flows into SAP S/4HANA and connected BTP workflows for order management, inventory, warehouse and finance operations. Shared services unify procurement, logistics and sales data, while forecasting and conversational decision-support layers help employees and dealers act on the same operational signals in one workflow.
business_outcome: Daikin created a repeatable transformation model that improved financial-close speed, branch productivity and rollout velocity while giving dealers and employees a more unified digital experience and a platform that can be extended across future phases of global standardization.
